plan: Drive: from Chilanko Forks, about 119 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 51.46538, -123.2493, pull off on A20019 Cp X30 Blk 3 (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: the A20019 Cp 29X/30X stretch, 3.3 km one way. About 65 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).

Legal: MU (Management Unit) 5-4, Region 5. Season: grouse sooty (dusky, blue) Sept 10 to Nov 30 and more rows (synopsis page 44, 99%). 3 legal flags below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
